application.name: holoscan_camera_v4l2
application.description: Reference graph for the Holoscan Camera V4L2 source, reporting how much of the acquisition contract survives to the far end of the pipeline

changelog.0.2.0: Streams from a real device in the capture mode and surveys capture-time coverage, sample flags, and end-to-end latency

validate.description: Compile the V4L2 graph without opening a camera

capture.description: Stream 60 frames from /dev/video0 and report what survived; requires a YUYV capture device
